title: Environment Contract
description: Source of truth for GitHub Environment variables required by deployment workflows

AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP.description: Azure Resource Group containing the staging Container App

CONTAINER_APP_NAME.description: Name of the staging Azure Container App

STAGING_URL.description: Public URL of the staging application

FEATURE_OVERTURN_METRICS.description: Enables the server-side overturn-metrics analytics endpoint (PR #249). Client card visibility is controlled by the VITE_FEATURE_OVERTURN_METRICS Docker build arg.

AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP.description: Azure Resource Group containing the production Container App

CONTAINER_APP_NAME.description: Name of the production Azure Container App

PRODUCTION_URL.description: Public URL of the production application

FEATURE_OVERTURN_METRICS.description: Enables the server-side overturn-metrics analytics endpoint. Not set in production until validated in staging.

sharedSecrets.description: Repository-level secrets used by both environments (sensitive credentials)

deprecatedSecrets.description: These secrets should NOT be used - use environment-scoped vars instead

buildArgs.description: Docker build-time arguments passed via --build-arg. Vite inlines VITE_* values at compile time so a single image serves all environments; server-side feature flags gate actual data access per-environment.

VITE_FEATURE_OVERTURN_METRICS.description: Enables the OverturnMetricsCard in the Vite client bundle. Server-side FEATURE_OVERTURN_METRICS still gates the analytics endpoint.

rules.description: Deploy jobs must declare environment: staging or production
Environment URLs must start with https://
